name: Match2Pay crypto payments for WooCommerce
author: Match2pay Ltd.

sections.description:
Match2Pay is a cryptocurrency payment infrastructure designed to help your business scale. Our plugin provides a seamless, secure, and fully automated way to accept 100+ cryptocurrencies while settling instantly in stablecoins or fiat to eliminate volatility.

Why Match2Pay?

Unlike retail-focused processors, Match2Pay is engineered for stability, high conversion, and transparency. We offer a “Pay as you use” model with no minimum monthly fees, making it the ideal choice for both scaling startups and global enterprises.

Core Features

  • Instant 1:1 Settlement: Eliminate crypto price volatility. Receive the exact value of your transactions in USD/EUR or stablecoins (USDT/USDC) with guaranteed 1:1 conversion and zero hidden spreads.
  • 500+ Wallet Connectivity: Boost checkout conversion with our “Connect & Confirm” flow. Customers can pay directly via MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Phantom, and 500+ other wallets – no manual address copying required.
  • Binance Pay Integration: Offer your customers the familiarity of Binance Pay for instant, one-click payments with lower rejection risks.
  • Zero Chargeback Risk: Protect your revenue from the friendly fraud common in credit card payments. All crypto transactions are final and secure.
  • Global Reach & Compliance-Ready: Operate worldwide with a solution regulated under the Seychelles FSA framework, featuring built-in AML/KYT monitoring and Travel Rule compliance.

Advanced Functionality

  • Automated Payouts: Effortlessly manage mass payouts to partners or players with no processing fees on withdrawals.
  • Detailed Reporting & Analytics: Monitor your business KPIs in real-time with intuitive web-based reports and charts.
  • Multi-Level Security: Your funds are protected by hardware cold storage, multi-signature controls, and 2FA for all sensitive operations.
  • Dedicated Support: Skip the ticketing system. Every Match2Pay client gets 24/7 a dedicated technical assistant.

Simple 48-Hour Integration

  1. Install the Plugin: Download and activate the Match2Pay plugin for WooCommerce.
  2. Connect via API: Enter your API keys from the Match2Pay merchant dashboard.
  3. Start Accepting: Go live within days and join over 500 businesses that trusted Match2Pay.

Contact

  • General inquiries: contact@match2pay.com
  • Technical support: support@match2pay.com
